timeline.tweet: It seems as though most of the smartest people suffer from depression. Might it be because they see the world as it is?

I have no money, I have no time, and I don't have much energy left. It's been stripped away from decades of working my ass off to only fall further behind. I would love to, but I don't have anything left thanks to bought politicians tearing apart everything.
I'm saddened by the amount of people that did show up.

I'm not suicidal like I once was. Yet, I still look forward to the end of struggle. The end of pain. Just sinking into nothing. Still, I push on. Fighting for what logic and reason show to be right. Doing what I need to do to stay alive and make a better world for my kids.
